## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Evidence

List the synthetic reproduction, relevant checks, and any measured result. Include the
population and denominator for metrics, and label estimates as estimates.

## Privacy and data boundary

- [ ] The change uses synthetic fixtures and examples only.
- [ ] No real financial document, user text, index, graph, projection, trace, or credential is included.
- [ ] User-document derivatives remain outside the repository.

## Project checklist

- [ ] Documentation is updated when setup, behavior, architecture, or workflow changed.
- [ ] Generated reports were regenerated rather than hand-edited.
- [ ] Third-party code or assets and their licenses are identified.
- [ ] The contribution can be distributed under Apache-2.0.
